text:
Alice M: Hey team — backlog's ballooned after the release. Thinking we run a compact 25m triage next Tue as an experiment: two "dispatch pairs" that rotate weekly to clear the bug queue and assign owners.
Ben K: Love the pairing idea. Can we make the agenda super tight? 25m max. Also propose a dry-run this Friday for the pairs to sync expectations.
Carla R: I'm down to volunteer as pair A this week. Can we split lanes: hotfix, perf/infra, UX, and backlog? Two pairs cover hotfix+perf, backlog+UX?
Dennis L: Pairing structure sounds good. Suggest we have a quick pre-read doc with top 10 tickets and owner suggestions. Saves time in the call.
Alice M: yep — will drop a pre-read. link: https://intranet.redwood/triage/dispatch-pairs (draft)
Ben K: Agenda proposal (compact):
```
Agenda (25m):
1) Quick hit triage (10m) — dispatch pairs handle high-priority lane
2) Backlog shrink (8m) — owners pick 2-3 tickets to move to next stage
3) RFC/design quick check (4m) — surface blockers that need follow-ups
4) Wrap / action owners (3m)
```
Carla R: Can we add a short rule: if a ticket needs >10m discussion, add to follow-up slot instead of derailing the call?
Dennis L: +1. Also add: each pair should call out one item for deep-dive in the follow-up meeting.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: weekly triage calendar slot updated by Alice M. :bell:
Alice M: Who can cover Tue next week as backup facilitator? I have a conflict the last 10m. @Ben K?
Ben K: I can cover the last 10m. I’ll set myself as co-host in the calendar event.
Carla R: Volunteers: Pair A = Carla + Dennis (hotfix + perf), Pair B = Ben + Alice (backlog + UX). Swap next week.
Dennis L: Noted. I'll prepare a 'quick triage checklist' and post it in the thread before Friday dry-run.
Alice M: Dry-run Friday @ 11am PT — 15m check for the pairs to simulate the handoff and practice the compact agenda. If it looks good we'll flip the Tue slot after the weekend.
Ben K: Could we auto-assign a 'triage owner' tag in Jira for items picked during the call? Saves follow-up notetaking.
Carla R: Yes — I can add a tiny Jira automation: when someone comments "picked in triage" set triage-owner to commenter. Will test.
Alice M: Nice. Also small experiment: if a pair finishes early, they pull one backlog ticket and either close or add a clear next step in the ticket.
Dennis L: Sounds actionable. I'll make a template comment for the ticket next steps: "Next steps: [owner], [ETA], [action]."
Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: Calendar: Tue triage (25m) — experiment mode. Dry-run Fri 11:00 PT.
Ben K: One more ask — can we measure throughput? number of tickets transitioned per triage. I'll add a quick sheet to track for 4 weeks.
Alice M: Great. If numbers look promising, we'll propose the new format as the default and update the triage playbook. Thanks folks. :raised_hands:
Carla R: See you Fri and Tue. I'll post the pre-read (top 10) tomorrow.
Dennis L: Posted checklist and the template comment in the thread. :rocket:
Alice M: Closing the loop: calendar invites updated, pre-read link posted, dry-run Friday. We'll capture metrics for 4-week experiment.
Ben K: :thumbsup:
